answer: A sponsor carries 66% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the whisper liability is entered in the reef ledger at admission, the delta audit publishes the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must thus place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
